title: HABIT-Bench: Evaluating Habit Induction from Longitudinal Weak Evidence in Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.24520v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In long-term interactions with large language model (LLM) agents, users reveal habits through their choices and actions. These habits capture implicit user information that agents must infer across conversations. However, individual observations may provide only partial evidence about a habit or when it applies. Retaining past interactions alone does not ensure that agents can infer habits and apply them appropriately. We introduce HABIT-Bench to evaluate how well agent memory systems infer habits from weak evidence and apply them to later requests. We construct synthetic user histories from task-oriented dialogue data and controlled habit graphs. The histories span hundreds of sessions across food, finance, software, and travel. Four-choice tasks assess agents' ability to infer user habits and apply them appropriately. They include temporary exceptions, changes in habits, and suggestions that users have not accepted. translated_title: HABIT-Bench：基于纵向弱证据评估智能体记忆中的习惯归纳
translated_abstract: 在与大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的长期交互中，用户通过他们的选择和行动展现出各种习惯。这些习惯蕴含着智能体必须跨对话推断的隐式用户信息。然而，单次观察可能仅提供关于某个习惯或其适用时机的部分证据。仅仅保留过去的交互记录并不能确保智能体能够推断出习惯并恰当地加以应用。我们提出HABIT-Bench，用于评估智能体记忆系统从弱证据中推断习惯并将其应用于后续请求的能力。我们基于任务导向对话数据和控制性习惯图谱构建了合成用户历史，这些历史横跨食品、金融、软件和旅行领域，包含数百个会话。四选一任务用于评估智能体推断用户习惯并恰当应用的能力，其中包括临时例外、习惯变化以及用户未曾接受的建议等情形。抽样任务……
tldr: 该论文提出HABIT-Bench基准，用于评估智能体记忆系统从长期交互中的微弱证据推断用户习惯并恰当地应用于后续请求的能力，涵盖跨领域的数百个会话和包含临时例外、习惯变化等复杂情形的四选一任务。
en_tdlr: HABIT-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating how well agent memory systems infer user habits from longitudinal weak evidence and apply them appropriately to later requests, using four-choice tasks spanning hundreds of sessions across multiple domains with challenges like temporary exceptions and habit changes.
